Directions: Refer to the following excerpt, then answer each question that follows.
Content: “Current sit-ins and other demonstrations are concerned with something much bigger than a hamburger... Whatever may be the difference in approach to their goal ... students, North and South, are seeking to rid America of the scourge of ... discrimination - not only at lunch counters, but in every aspect of life.”
